lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu12Ge12 (reduced formula LuGe) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 119), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives all Ge and Lu centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; Ge–Ge and Ge–Lu distances range from about 2.81 to 3.07 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Ge- and Lu-centered coordination polyhedra.
